subject: Posterior samples of SPDE Matern covariance parameters

messages.author: 9ff9a4bf8138ea25
messages.subject: Posterior samples of SPDE Matern covariance parameters
parts:
Hi INLA group,

I am using inla.hyperpar.sample(n, output, intern = FALSE) to obtain samples for the hyperparameters (particularly covariance parameters) of a SPDE Matern model. The posterior samples I get are for (theta1, theta2), but I am actually interested in the samples for (kappa, variance.nominal, range.nominal).

When analyzing the inference results, I normally use inla.spde2.result to extract the marginal posterior of these parameters for a SPDE object. Is there any equivalent way of doing so but for the samples I obtain using inla.hyperpar.sample?

Thanks
-I

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Posterior samples of SPDE Matern covariance parameters
parts:
Hi,
You can use the definition of the log-linear link between kappa, tau, and theta1,theta2 as defined by B.kappa and B.tau. For these links, as well as how to convert into range and standard deviations for the SPDE, please read the "read this first" paper here:
http://www.r-inla.org/examples/tutorials

Finn
